Name: Seed Identifying Buddy
Author: SorceressNadira
Description:
I found myself having more Mixed Seeds than I will ever need and there came the idea for a THING that would allow to sort them into something more... predictable. Around the same time I fell in love with bird designs made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81086143]ivylovesbirds[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91742873]Mazoout[/url], and with their permissions ([b]thank you so much!![/b]) I used those designs in my little Seed Buddy.

I wanted to make the mod compatible with those that I am using myself, and so you can select the following options for it:
[list]
[*]Vanilla Seeds from base game (enabled by default)
[*]Cornucopia [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]flowers[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]crops[/url] Seeds (disabled by default)﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26402]Faeries Horticulture[/url] Seeds (disabled by default)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living[/url] Seeds (disabled by default)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20598]Lumisteria Serene Meadow[/url] Seeds (NEW) (disabled by default)﻿

[*]additionally, you can opt for allowing to identify Seasonal Seeds as well as Mixed Seeds and Mixed Flower Seeds (enabled y default)
[/list]Additionally, you don't really need to have those mods installed, as Buddy will work without them as well!

Once your Farmer reaches lvl5 in Farming, you will be able to craft Buddy from the crafting menu.

So go ahead and add a Buddy to your farm (note that birds are not really fond of enclosed spaces, hence keeping it in a building will not make it happy!) and most importantly - check out these mods if you haven't already!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14510]Bird overhaul - Ornithologist's Guild[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/81086143]ivylovesbirds[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26599]Eurasian Birds for Ornithologist's Guild[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/91742873]Mazoout
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20598]Lumisteria Serene Meadow[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/147754183]PlatinumCats
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26402]Faeries Horticulture[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45972757]Lavliette[/url]﻿
Many thanks to you, lovely mod creators, for sharing your talent!
